short_description: Convert every hour between two cities on a selected date, including daylight saving changes.
description: Convert every hour between two cities on a selected date, including daylight saving changes. Set from_zone and to_zone to IANA names, date to YYYY-MM-DD (or leave empty for the current source-zone date), and start_hour to the first displayed hour. Turn through all hours. Missing spring-forward hours are marked skipped, and both fall-back occurrences get a separate destination reading.
changelog: New screen transitions and high-contrast LED previews.
